simulator.note: The bootloader runs (run_dump_a102e_security_ic.py): it prints "APP  init!", parks the SEE through its boot code at 0xA1E90C60, writes the PT6964 front panel on STB=39 / CLK=38 / DIO=40 and unpacks the SEE's program, then has the board's security IC (I2C 0x62 on GPIO 44 / 43) decrypt the first 1 KB of the main code in 64 blocks of 16 bytes (each with a CRC-16/BUYPASS checksum).  Without the security IC's unknown key, LzmaDecode() receives an empty buffer and jumps to 0x80000200.

desc: Ferguson Ariva 102E official firmware V1.27B3 (2015-03-24) for the Full HD DVB-S2 satellite receiver with smartcard reader on the dual-CPU ALi M3606 (0x3603) platform.

Uses bootloader "HS17" (version 37017-01047), drives a 3-wire PT6964 front-panel controller on GPIO 38..40 (CLK=38, STB=39, DIO=40), and exchanges 64 CRC-16/BUYPASS-protected 16-byte maincode blocks with the board's security IC at I2C 0x62 over GPIO 44 / 43 (SCL=44, SDA=43).
